Produced by github.com/BullionBear/mftiko v0.8.0 (commit c769041),
internal/platform/sealbox/sealbox.go Seal and SealCredentials.
cpanel does not import that package. These files are test vectors, not deployment keys.

recipient.priv / recipient.pub
    X25519 key pair. The private key is standard base64. It is not a host secret.

mftiko_plain.bin
    Plaintext passed to Seal. mftiko_seal.bin is the sealed box.

mftiko_credentials.plain
    proto.Marshal of mftiko state.v1.AccountCredentials:
    api_id 42, kind BinanceUM, key_type hmac,
    key vector-api-key, secret vector-api-secret, passphrase vector-passphrase.
    mftiko_credentials.bin is that message sealed with SealCredentials.
    The strings are fixtures, not an exchange key.
